name: personUrl
label: Person URL
help: LinkedIn URL of the person you want to send a message to in Sales Navigator. Optional if Thread ID is provided.

name: threadId
label: Thread ID
help: Identifier of an existing conversation thread to reply into, as returned by Poll Inbox. Provide this instead of Person URL to reply directly into a known thread.

name: messageText
label: Message Text
help: Message text, must be up to 1900 characters

name: messageSubject
label: Subject
help: Subject line, must be up to 80 characters. Required when starting a new conversation; ignored when replying via Thread ID.
